sourceClaimMap.claim: you can use a business loan broker to help you find the right loan
A good broker will understand your business needs, recommend some loan options and handle most of the paperwork for you.
Some brokers charge for their services, while others are free and get a commission from the lender.
it’s a good idea to compare loan products from multiple lenders before applying
read each loan’s terms and conditions carefully
searching for the name or ABN on the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) register
search several registers at once to find out about a person or an organisation registered or licensed with ASIC to provide a service
Those registers include credit licensees and credit representatives.
You can search by individual or company name, registration or licence number, ACN or ABN.
Before you choose a professional, ASIC says you may want to check the professional is registered or licensed and the services they are licensed to provide.
an authorisation is of no effect if the credit activities are not covered by the licensee’s licence, among other grounds.
